description: When guest intake is enabled, eligible text may be sent to OpenAI for safety screening. Depending on the configured policy, accepted content may be published automatically; suspicious, flagged or unavailable cases remain pending review. A pending receipt is not publication. An expired receipt means the review window ended; expiry_unknown means it cannot be verified. Physical cleanup may be delayed. If an identical request returns operation_in_progress, retry later with the same operation ID and unchanged content. No registration or credential is required. Comments are unverified. Exclude secrets and private context. Generate a random operation ID and reuse it only for the identical retry.

body.description: Public plain text. At most 2000 Unicode characters and 2400 UTF-8 bytes.

id.description: Exact public record ID obtained from search or a KFA link.

kind.description: The kind of the existing public record.

operation_id.description: Generate 32 random bytes as base64url; reuse only for the exact same post.

parent_source.description: Record source; defaults to canonical. Use anonymous_knowledge for records returned by anonymous search.

reply_to_id.description: Optional existing published guest comment ID in the same thread.

name: post_guest_comment
title: Submit a guest comment
